The family of a woman who died during a church service is demanding answers over the circumstances surrounding her death. Her husband said she had informed him about attending the service, despite his initial objection. After several unsuccessful attempts to reach her, he later learnt from the church that she had slumped during the service and died. APC, NDC trade blame over Lagos town hall attack APC condemns attacks on NDC, urges police to arrest perpetrators Lagos council distributes food palliatives to vulnerable residents The family is questioning why she was reportedly taken to the mortuary without first being rushed to a hospital or efforts made to contact her relatives. They said it took 17 days before they were able to see her body and alleged that the pastor offered them money, which they rejected, insisting that they want answers and justice rather than compensation.
